ConditionalA26.projected_native_divisor_comparison.{u_1, u_2} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H]
  [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (E : Submodule ℂ H) [CompleteSpace ↥E] (f : ℂ → ℂ) (a alpha s : ℝ)
  (T : ConditionalA19.Zero f → ℂ)
  (b : HilbertBasis ((z : ConditionalA19.Zero f) × Fin (ConditionalA19.selectedMultiplicity f a alpha s z)) ℂ ↥E)
  {κ : Type u_2} (ambient : HilbertBasis κ ℂ H) (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (u v : ℕ → H) (hc : Summable fun n => ‖u n‖ * ‖v n‖)
  (hPA : ∀ (x : H), HasSum (fun n => ⟪u n, x⟫_ℂ • v n) (E.starProjection (A x)))
  (lower :
    (z : ConditionalA19.Zero f) × Fin (ConditionalA19.selectedMultiplicity f a alpha s z) →
      Finset ((z : ConditionalA19.Zero f) × Fin (ConditionalA19.selectedMultiplicity f a alpha s z)))
  (coef :
    (z : ConditionalA19.Zero f) × Fin (ConditionalA19.selectedMultiplicity f a alpha s z) →
      (z : ConditionalA19.Zero f) × Fin (ConditionalA19.selectedMultiplicity f a alpha s z) → ℂ)
  (hproper : ∀ (i : (z : ConditionalA19.Zero f) × Fin (ConditionalA19.selectedMultiplicity f a alpha s z)), i ∉ lower i)
  (hflag :
    ∀ (i : (z : ConditionalA19.Zero f) × Fin (ConditionalA19.selectedMultiplicity f a alpha s z)) (x : ↥E),
      ⟪↑(b i), A ↑x⟫_ℂ = T i.fst * ⟪b i, x⟫_ℂ + ∑ j ∈ lower i, coef i j * ⟪b j, x⟫_ℂ)
  (hfull : Summable fun z => ‖↑(analyticOrderNatAt f ↑z) * T z‖) (geometric pole : ℂ)
  (hexplicit : geometric = pole - ∑' (z : ConditionalA19.Zero f), ↑(analyticOrderNatAt f ↑z) * T z) :
  geometric =
    pole - ∑' (n : ℕ), ⟪u n, v n⟫_ℂ -
      ∑' (z : ConditionalA19.Zero f),
        ↑(analyticOrderNatAt f ↑z - ConditionalA19.selectedMultiplicity f a alpha s z) * T z
